elements.name: nCS-AN

elements.description: Parameter $$ N^{(1)}_{PUCCH} $$ (36.213)

elements.name: pusch-ConfigCommon
elements.description: Specifies the common PUSCH configuration

elements.name: ul-ReferenceSignalsPUSCH
elements.description: Used to specify parameters needed for the transmission on PUSCH (or PUCCH).

elements.name: groupHoppingEnabled
elements.description: Indicates if group hopping is enabled for PUSCH DMRS.

elements.name: groupAssignmentPUSCH
elements.description: Parameter $$ \delta_{ss} $$ for PUSCH DMRS sequence hopping.

elements.name: sequenceHoppingEnabled
elements.description: Indicates if sequence hopping is enabled for PUSCH DMRS.

elements.name: cyclicShift
elements.description: Cyclic shift for PUSCH DMRS (applicable when sequence hopping is disabled).

elements.name: enable64QAM
elements.description: Indicates if 64QAM modulation is enabled for PUSCH.

elements.name: numberOfRA-Preambles
elements.description: Number of non-dedicated random access preambles in 36.321. Value n4 corresponds to 4, n8 corresponds to 8 and so on.

elements.name: preamblesGroupAConfig
elements.description: Configuration of RA preambles group A in 36.321.

elements.name: sizeOfRA-PreamblesGroupA
elements.description: Size of the random access preambles group A in 36.321.

elements.name: messageSizeGroupA
elements.description: Threshold for preamble selection in 36.321. Value b56 corresponds to 56 bits, b144 corresponds to 144 bits and so on.

elements.name: messagePowerOffsetGroupB
elements.type: ENUMERATED {minusinfinity, dB0, dB5, dB8, dB10, dB12, dB15, dB18}
elements.description: Threshold for preamble selection in 36.321. Value minusinfinity corresponds to –infinity. Value dB0 corresponds to 0 dB, dB5 corresponds to 5 dB and so on.

elements.name: powerRampingParameters
elements.description: Parameters for power ramping in 36.321

elements.name: powerRampingStep
elements.description: Power ramping factor in 36.321. Value in dB. Value dB0 corresponds to 0 dB, dB2 corresponds to 2 dB and so on.

elements.name: preambleInitialReceivedTargetPower
elements.type: ENUMERATED {dBm-120, dBm-118, dBm-116, dBm-114, dBm-112, dBm-110, dBm-108, dBm-106, dBm-104, dBm-102, dBm-100, dBm-98, dBm-96, dBm-94, dBm-92, dBm-90}
elements.description: Initial preamble power in TS 36.321. Value in dBm. Value dBm-120 corresponds to -120 dBm, dBm-118 corresponds to -118 dBm and so on.

elements.name: preambleTransMax
elements.type: ENUMERATED {n3, n4, n5, n6, n7, n8, n10, n20, n50, n100, n200}
elements.description: Maximum number of preamble retransmissions (TS 36.321).

elements.name: ra-ResponseWindowSize
elements.type: ENUMERATED {sf2, sf3, sf4, sf5, sf6, sf7, sf8, sf10}
elements.description: Size of the Random Access Response window in subframes (TS 36.321). The same value applies for each serving cell (although the associated functionality is performed independently for each cell)

elements.name: mac-ContentionResolutionTimer
elements.type: ENUMERATED {sf8, sf16, sf24, sf32, sf40, sf48, sf56, sf64}
elements.description: Timer for MAC contention resolution in subframes (TS 36.321).

elements.name: maxHARQ-Msg3Tx
elements.description: Maximum number of HARQ retransmissions for Msg3 in contention based random access procedure (TS 36.321).

elements.name: preambleTransMax-CE-r13
elements.type: ENUMERATED {n3, n4, n5, n6, n7, n8, n10, n20, n50, n100, n200}
elements.description: Maximum number of preamble retransmissions for Coverage Enhancement (CE) mode.

elements.name: rach-CE-LevelInfoList-r13
elements.description: Provides RACH information for each coverage level. The first entry in the list contains RACH information of CE level 0, the second entry in the list contains RACH information of CE level 1, and so on.

elements.name: ra-ResponseWindowSize-r13
elements.type: ENUMERATED {sf20, sf50, sf80, sf120, sf180, sf240, sf320, sf400}

elements.name: bcch-Config
elements.description: Common configuration for the BCCH.

elements.name: modificationPeriodCoeff
elements.description: Coefficient for the modification period of system information (TS 36.331). Relates to the SFN boundary at which SIB changes take effect.

elements.name: pcch-Config
elements.description: Common configuration for the PCCH.

elements.name: defaultPagingCycle
elements.description: Default paging cycle, used to derive 'T' in TS 36.304. rf32 corresponds to 32 radio frames, etc.

elements.name: nB
elements.type: ENUMERATED {fourT, twoT, oneT, halfT, quarterT, oneEighthT, oneSixteenthT, oneThirtySecondT}
elements.description: Used in paging frame and paging occasion calculation (TS 36.304). Value in multiples or fractions of the default paging cycle 'T'.

elements.name: prach-Config
